name: grain
summary: A soft blob gradient with real film grain, plus a grain overlay for anything.
props: sunset | ocean | aurora | dusk | peach | graphite | ember | mint | lavender | candy | forest | noir
Base colour first, then up to four blob colours. Overrides palette.
Root style; give it a size or flex: 1.
Grain only, laid over its parent.
behavior: A base colour with up to four radial blobs, drawn with react-native-svg so it scales to any size.
A tiny tiling noise image drawn at 2×, so the speckle stays fine on every screen; grain sets its strength.
The gradient and grain never take touches; children render on top.
